open_points.subject: 00_product.md:Decisions
open_points.text: Other services keep no customer record and no copy of these values; An alias whose content breaks the owner's rule carries a personal value into a snapshot by that breach, not by a copy R0-80 forbids
open_points.question: If an alias contains the customer's name or the object's address verbatim, is keeping that alias a forbidden copy of the value or an allowed snapshot field because Registry classifies the alias as business_confidential?
options: It is a forbidden copy and must not be kept
It remains an allowed alias despite its content
It is allowed initially but must be removed under a defined remediation rule
open_points.default_guess: Treat the content, not the field label, as controlling and forbid keeping the violating value.

witness.initial: The object address is "Pedreres 35", and a consumer may keep the project's alias.
events: The owner sets the alias to "Pedreres 35".
The consumer reads the project and stores that alias in its snapshot.
outcomes: R0-80 forbids the consumer from keeping it because it is a copy of the object's address.
R0-90 permits the snapshot because it obtained an alias rather than a Registry field classified as personal_data.
witness.observer: The consumer, the owner and the customer whose address remains stored

open_points.subject: 00_product.md:Decisions
open_points.text: the owner ends it by correcting the alias
open_points.question: How can the owner correct a rule-breaking alias on an archived project when R0-12 says an archived project cannot be corrected?
options: Permit alias-only correction on archived projects
Require anonymising or deleting the archived project
Add a separate remediation action that is not project correction
open_points.default_guess: Add a narrowly scoped owner action that may replace or clear an alias even after archival.

witness.initial: An archived project has an alias containing a person's name, and a consumer snapshot holds it.
events: The owner attempts to correct or clear the alias.
outcomes: The correction is refused because archive is final.
The correction succeeds because R0-90 says this is how the owner ends the breach.
witness.observer: The owner and every consumer retaining the alias

open_points.subject: 00_product.md:Decisions
open_points.text: once its consumer reads the project again
open_points.question: Which consumers and which Registry read operation constitute reading the project again and therefore refresh the kept snapshot?
options: Only PresuPro and Client Portal, through their full project read
Every service allowed to keep an identity snapshot, including Cabinet
Any successful response carrying project identity, including context or a projection
Refresh is an internal consumer action not tied to a particular Registry operation
open_points.default_guess: Apply the rule to every consumer permitted to keep a snapshot, and replace it after any successful identity read that returns the current alias.

witness.initial: A consumer holds a snapshot with a violating alias, and Registry now holds a corrected alias.
events: The consumer calls context but does not call the full project-read operation.
outcomes: The context read counts, so the snapshot is replaced with the corrected alias.
Only a full project read counts, so the old alias remains in the snapshot.
witness.observer: The consumer and anyone shown its locally stored project identity

open_points.subject: 00_product.md:Decisions
open_points.text: a snapshot holds the corrected alias once its consumer reads the project again
open_points.question: Must the successful reread replace and erase every previously kept alias value, or may the consumer retain the former snapshot or history alongside the corrected snapshot?
options: Atomically replace the sole snapshot and erase the former alias
Keep snapshot history, including the former alias
Update the current snapshot but remove the former alias on a separate retention schedule
open_points.default_guess: Require atomic replacement of the sole kept snapshot and removal of the former alias.

witness.initial: A consumer keeps a snapshot containing a person's name as the alias.
events: The owner corrects the alias to "P35".
The consumer reads the project again and stores the new result.
outcomes: The old snapshot is replaced, so the person's name is no longer kept.
The new snapshot is added while the old snapshot or cache remains, so the person's name is still kept.
witness.observer: The consumer, its operators and the affected person

open_points.subject: 00_product.md:Decisions
open_points.text: the owner ends it by correcting the alias, and a snapshot holds the corrected alias once its consumer reads the project again
open_points.question: What completes remediation when a consumer is offline, has been retired, fails its reread, or never reads the project again?
options: The stale alias may remain indefinitely and correction only changes Registry
Snapshots have a maximum age and must expire
Registry pushes or records an invalidation that consumers must apply
The owner has a revoke-or-delete action for the consumer's snapshot
open_points.default_guess: Define a bounded snapshot lifetime and require consumers to discard an expired snapshot until a successful refresh.

witness.initial: A consumer snapshot contains a rule-breaking alias.
events: The owner corrects the alias in Registry.
The consumer remains offline and never performs another successful read.
outcomes: The owner has ended the breach, so the stale snapshot must be invalidated or removed by some specified mechanism.
The snapshot keeps the personal value indefinitely because refresh occurs only on a later read.
witness.observer: The affected person, the owner and anyone with access to the consumer's stored snapshot
